Rem / Re:Zero character and supplied reference illustrations belong to their respective rights holders.
This v4 package contains 13 newly generated reference-based artworks and rigs, plus a separate lpk-original choice containing the byte-identical author runtime verified in the earlier 8812 delivery. The newly generated artwork is not the author's original costume artwork. The original author directory remains untouched.
Original author model: 蕾姆, Steam Workshop item 2217310220 (Akina); source config names BigJJ. Bilibili reference: BV1LA411n7QL (深井玑). Original MOC, texture, physics and five expression files are retained unchanged; no original-model authorship is claimed.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2217310220
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1LA411n7QL/
The third-party character/model artwork is not covered by the software MIT/GPL notices.

Artwork: built-in image_gen, one three-state source sheet per user-supplied outfit reference. Exact prompts and source-image paths are recorded in art/generation-records.json. Raw generation files are preserved byte-for-byte.
Model export: psd2live 5526f2e16b57e5f83d34f33730d6fa26d8bc8695 with local Live2D agent-kit manifest integration. Engine is GPL-3.0; its license and notices are retained. Engine executable, JDK and Android SDK are not bundled. Recipes and generated PSD/CMO3/runtime outputs are included.
Kit source: https://github.com/Ariakage/live2d-agent-kit

Runtime: Live2D Cubism Core Web 5.1.0, copyright Live2D Inc. Separate proprietary terms apply; Core is not MIT/GPL. Original headers retained.
Core source: https://cubism.live2d.com/sdk-web/core/05/live2dcubismcore.min.js
PixiJS 6.5.10 and pixi-live2d-display 0.4.0 retain their MIT notices. Cubism Framework code within the display bundle retains its separate Live2D terms.
Test speech is Microsoft Huihui Desktop system speech, not Rem voice or the model author's voice.
This working package does not grant ownership of third-party character, reference-art or SDK rights.
